info.description: REST API untuk personal anime library.
info.title: Libra - Anime Library API

get.description: Get a paginated list of popular anime.

post.description: Identify an anime scene from an image URL using trace.moe.

get.description: Search anime by title, external ID, season, year, genre, status, or format.
Get anime details by AniList external ID.

post.description: Authenticate a user and return an authentication token.
Create a new user account and return an authentication token.

get.description: Get all anime groups belonging to the authenticated user.

post.description: Create a new anime group for the authenticated user.

get.description: Get a specific group belonging to the authenticated user.

delete.description: Delete a group belonging to the authenticated user.

patch.description: Update the name or description of a group belonging to the authenticated user.

get.description: Get all library anime assigned to a specific group.

post.description: Add an anime from the user's library to a group.

404.description: Group or library anime not found

delete.description: Remove an anime from a group without deleting it from the user's library.

400.description: Invalid group ID or library anime ID

404.description: Group or anime in group not found

get.description: Get all anime in the authenticated user's library.

post.description: Add an anime from AniList to the authenticated user's library.

get.description: Get a specific anime from the authenticated user's library.

delete.description: Remove an anime from the authenticated user's library.

patch.description: Update the user's anime status, episode progress, rating, notes, or dates.

get.description: Get the profile of the currently authenticated user.

patch.description: Update the username and/or email of the currently authenticated user.
